)

  synced_at = NOW();

WITH picked_rate AS (
    SELECT r.rate_id, r.currency, r.hourly_rate_cents
    FROM assignee_rates r
    WHERE r.assignee_id = $3::text
      AND daterange(date_trunc('day', $6::timestamptz)::date,
                    date_trunc('day', $6::timestamptz)::date + 1, '[]') && r.valid_daterange
    ORDER BY r.valid_from DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
calc AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.rate_id,
        pr.currency,
        pr.hourly_rate_cents,
        ROUND(COALESCE(pr.hourly_rate_cents, 0) * $8::numeric)::bigint AS cost_cents
    FROM picked_rate pr
)
INSERT INTO clickup_time_entries (
    time_entry_id, task_id, user_id, user_name, user_email,
    start_time, end_time, duration_hours, billable, description,
    rate_id, currency, hourly_rate_cents, cost_cents
)
VALUES (
    $1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4, $5,
    $6::timestamptz, $7::timestamptz, $8::numeric, $9::boolean, $10,
    (SELECT rate_id FROM calc),
    (SELECT currency FROM calc),
    (SELECT hourly_rate_cents FROM calc),
    (SELECT cost_cents FROM calc)
)
ON CONFLICT (time_entry_id) DO UPDATE SET
    user_name = EXCLUDED.user_name,
    user_email = EXCLUDED.user_email,
    start_time = EXCLUDED.start_time,
    end_time = EXCLUDED.end_time,
    duration_hours = EXCLUDED.duration_hours,
    billable = EXCLUDED.billable,
    description = EXCLUDED.description,
    rate_id = EXCLUDED.rate_id,
    currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
    hourly_rate_cents = EXCLUDED.hourly_rate_cents,
    cost_cents = EXCLUDED.cost_cents,
    synced_at = NOW();
